text: In the Zorn's-lemma proof that every vector space has a basis, Zorn's lemma is applied to which poset?
choices: All subspaces of V, ordered by inclusion
All spanning sets of V, ordered by inclusion
All linearly independent subsets of V, ordered by inclusion
All finite subsets of V, ordered by cardinality
explanation: Chains of independent sets are bounded above by their union — any finite dependence would already occur in one member of the chain — so Zorn gives a maximal independent set B. Maximality forces B to span: otherwise adjoining a vector outside span(B) would keep independence.
